_meta.status: Step 2 ratified (V15); combat-facing hooks now numeric in COMBAT.md 11
_meta.sources: DESIGN.md v0.4 §2.18/§10/§11 · RACES.md v0.2 mechanical hooks (ratified) · fighter.schema.json example ids
provenance_notes: Trait ids follow the bare snake_case style of the schema example (patient_hunter, et_y_bellum_devout, kier_hardened).

Effects are v0 loose modifier bags in the item.schema.json style. As of COMBAT.md v0.2 (ratified), the 55 combat-facing hooks have numeric conversions in COMBAT.md 11.1; the remainder are explicitly deferred to their own steps in COMBAT.md 11.3. No trait entry in this file changed.

draw: 'pool' traits are rolled from weighted pools by recruitgen; draw: 'special' traits are rolled by their own rules (race rates in races.json, line constants in recruitment.json) and never appear in ordinary pool draws.
rarity → weight mapping lives in recruitment.json. race_weight / origin_weight multiply a trait's base weight for matching fighters.
Everything in this file is (proposed) unless tagged canon in its notes.

Step 5 (PROCUREMENT.md P10): race-locked ITEMS are struck from the design, so `wing_rig_synergy` lost the thermal rig it hooked into and is retired from updraft_ace. The trait is unchanged in effect — `flight_mobility_bonus` already pays the 1.35 -> 1.20 hover exposure. race_locked on TRAITS is untouched.

traits.name: Et-y-Bellum Devout
traits.description: Holds the faith openly: battle is the sacrament their people were made for.
traits.notes: Canon id (schema example). Rolled per races.json devotion_lines, not the pool. Cede friction is the ratified spicier variant.

traits.name: Et-y-Bellum Zealot
traits.description: The sacrament is everything. Evacuation is apostasy; a quiet death, heresy.
traits.notes: Zealots take the Et- honorific (ratified). Rolled per races.json devotion_lines.

traits.name: Psion: Battle-Sense
traits.description: Feels the shot a heartbeat before the trigger. Moves first.
traits.notes: Psionics scope per RACES.md: rare line, one expression per psion. Rolled per races.json psionics rates.

traits.name: Psion: Squad-Link
traits.description: A whisper of the Mon-Wa gift: the squad simply knows where they are.

traits.name: Psion: Pressure-Read
traits.description: Sits in on negotiations. Tells you, afterward, which offers were bluffs.

decoration.manager_facing_utility: a reading of a manager, with nothing for it to read

traits.notes: The manager-facing expression — feeds the Step 6 negotiation engine.

traits.name: Cradleborn Resentment
traits.description: Serves the fleet that spent their homeworld, and never once forgets it did.

decoration.delicacy_harvest_friction: no delicacy or harvest economy exists to have friction with

traits.notes: Canon thread (DESIGN.md §2.18, §3.3). Never rolls on humans — the Spent Cradles are not theirs to mourn. Rates per races.json resentment_rate.

traits.name: Ankoth Sympathizer
traits.description: Has read the pamphlets. Privately thinks the banished had a point about the Divide.

decoration.hidden_leaning: its events fire; concealing a conviction wants a discovery path

traits.notes: Quiet undercurrent per §3.5 — any race, humans included; far likelier alongside cradleborn_resentment. Rates in recruitment.json. Scandal system lands at Step 9.

traits.name: Keshu Grudge
traits.description: The War for Keshu ended fifty-five years ago. Some households never signed the peace.
traits.notes: Ratified spice from RACES.md — friction with the other Keshu race, or the long road to an unlikely friendship. Rates in recruitment.json.
